### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **20** documentable anchor(s).

**48** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0283cb924a5e29f22fdf0db60bcaedeab3ead3f3`.

⛔ **13** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **137** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0283cb924a5e29f22fdf0db60bcaedeab3ead3f3` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `d500e979006b884b3a54fd9e4c1db5e3e9b7d3b9` — the merge of head `169b0cc79452c0b7edb4870eb1185aaec5df44f3` into base `0283cb924a5e29f22fdf0db60bcaedeab3ead3f3`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin d500e979006b884b3a54fd9e4c1db5e3e9b7d3b9 && git checkout d500e979006b884b3a54fd9e4c1db5e3e9b7d3b9
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0283cb924a5e29f22fdf0db60bcaedeab3ead3f3 169b0cc79452c0b7edb4870eb1185aaec5df44f3 && git checkout -B drift-repro 0283cb924a5e29f22fdf0db60bcaedeab3ead3f3 && git merge --no-ff 169b0cc79452c0b7edb4870eb1185aaec5df44f3

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0283cb924a5e29f22fdf0db60bcaedeab3ead3f3
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0283cb924a5e29f22fdf0db60bcaedeab3ead3f3` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `169b0cc79452c0b7edb4870eb1185aaec5df44f3`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #19332 body and all 14 comments (ruling `5861442317`, the analysis report `5859943900`, the decision box, the #20362 ACCEPT and landing, the `action.aria` retirement note `5865896639`, claim `5866942536`, dev report `5868574063`); PR #20428 body, its 10-file list and the net diff against `main` (GitHub's diff is byte-for-byte `git diff 789b2ae5..169b0cc7`, 925 lines); the check-runs on the head. Tree readings are `git show` / `git grep` at `169b0cc7` and `origin/main`; the objectui readings are `git show` at the `.objectui-sha` pin `f8a9d0fb0` in the sibling checkout. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**Accept set — does not move (right).** The diff touches no `*.zod.ts`, no ledger, no `api-surface/`, no `authorable-surface/`; every schema-side claim in the PR body was checked against the schema at the head. `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY` is declared as an opaque readonly record of `FormView` (`metadata-form-registry.ts:67`), so row contents are not a declared surface. `Lint & Repo Gates` (`check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:generated`, `check:i18n`) is `success` on the head. The public surface that moves is exactly what the changeset names: the form payload `getMetaTypes()` serves and the four regenerated `platform-objects` metadata-form bundles (19 keys × 4 locales, key sets identical across the four; `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` are authored translations, not English copies; no extractor fill or source-hash row).

**The 16 rows, each against its schema node, its mirror row and the ruling.** Every mirror row the PR body names exists at the head and carries the face claimed:

| key | node at head | face | mirror (verified) | ruling fit |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `field.visibleWhen` / `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen` | `EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema` (`field.zod.ts:1765-1767`) | `type: 'code'`, `language: 'expression'` | `object.form.ts:347-349`, same keys, same face | right — code/expression |
| `field.lookupFilters` | `array(strictObject{field, operator enum incl. notIn, value})` (:1602) | `widget: 'json'`, no inline options | `object.form.ts:253`, same key, same face | right — `notIn` is unspellable as an option value |
| `field.lookupColumns` | `array(union(string, strictObject{field,label,width,type}))` (:1591) | `json` | the same `lookupFilters` row | right — union, never `string-tags` |
| `field.dependsOn` | `array(union(string, strictObject{field,param}))` (:1617) | `json` | same | right — union, never `string-tags` |
| `field.accept` | `array(string)` (:1322) | `string-tags` | `app.form.ts:102` `requiredPermissions`, `string-tags` | right |
| `field.relatedListColumns` | `array(string.min(1))`, column objects refused at parse (:1519) | `string-tags` | `app.form.ts:102` | right |
| `field.requiredPermissions` | `array(string)` (:1842) | `string-tags` | `app.form.ts:102` | right |
| `field.currencyConfig` | strict `{currencyMode: enum dynamic/fixed, defaultCurrency: string(3)}`; `precision` is a 17.5.0 tombstone (:478-490) | composite with declared select + text | `object.form.ts:453` `access` composite over a declared select | right — both option values are lowercase identifiers |
| `field.storage` | strict `{notNull: boolean}` (:1147) | composite with declared boolean | `object.form.ts:453` | right |
| `action.patch` | `record(string, unknown)` (`action.zod.ts:1137`) | `json`, gate `data.operation == 'update'` | `object.form.ts:424` `validations`, `json` | right — the parse refuses `patch` without `operation: 'update'` (:1761-1790) |
| `action.bodyExtra` | `record(string, unknown)` (:1537) | `json`, gate `data.type == 'api'` | same | right — refused beside `operation: 'update'` (`DECLARATIVE_UPDATE_REFUSED_KEYS`) |
| `action.description` | `I18nLabelSchema` (:966) | `widget: 'textarea'` | `page.form.ts:43` `description`, `I18nLabelSchema` at `page.zod.ts:766`, `textarea` | right |
| `action.errorMessage` | `I18nLabelSchema` (:1305) | plain row | `action.form.ts:118` `successMessage`, `I18nLabelSchema`, plain | right |
| `action.requiredPermissions` | `array(string)` (:1429) | `string-tags` | `app.form.ts:102` | right |

Sections match the PR table (field: Configuration for the six type-gated rows, Advanced for `storage`, the three predicates and `requiredPermissions`; action: Behavior for `patch` / `description` / `errorMessage`, Placement for `requiredPermissions`, Advanced for `bodyExtra`). No key had a prior row (the only other `visibleWhen` in `field.form.ts` is the per-option row inside the `options` repeater, catalogued as `options.visibleWhen`, a different key). The `currencyConfig` composite drops the `precision` sub-row the analysis table listed — right, the key is a tombstone at the head.

**Gates (8 rows).** Each gate is the runtime reader's set: `accept` shares `maxSize`'s five media types (both judged by `assertFileConstraints`); `currencyConfig` → `currency`; picker rows → `lookup` / `master_detail`; `dependsOn` adds the four option types (objectui `CheckboxesField` / cascading options read it at the pin); `patch` / `bodyExtra` follow the parse refusals. Right.

**Help text against the readers — no claim of a reading or a refusal that does not exist.** Checked each:
- `readonlyWhen`: `stripReadonlyWhenFields` (objectql `rule-validator.ts:971`) drops the caller's change to a locked field and keeps the stored value — "ignored rather than rejected", as the help text says. "objectstack validate refuses a read through a reference field" — lint #20078 (`validate-expressions.ts:1020-1115`, `:1368`) refuses exactly that on the two field-level slots. Holds.
- `requiredWhen`: transition gate — the schema describe (:1767) and `evaluateValidationRules`; refused beside `storage.notNull` — `field.zod.ts:2099-2115`. Holds.
- `field.requiredPermissions`: `foldFieldRequiredPermissions` (security-plugin `:8689`) is `caps.every(held)` (all-of) and sets `readable:false, editable:false`; the read image goes through `fieldMasker.maskResults` with the folded perms and, where a `maskingRule` applies, a partial rule. "masked on read (partially, when a maskingRule is set), edits denied" holds.
- `action.requiredPermissions`: `actionPermissionError` (runtime `action-execution.ts:408`) reports the missing subset; `domains/actions.ts:569` answers 403, `domains/mcp.ts:975` answers 403; the hide is `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx:484` `mayInvoke(action.requiredPermissions)` at the pin. Holds.
- `accept`: `assertFileConstraints` (`file-reference-lifecycle.ts:320`) re-checks the `accept` list against the stored `sys_file` MIME / name on write. Holds.
- `patch`: `declarativeUpdateWrite` is `{ ...patch, ...params }` — params win. Holds.
- `lookupFilters` "ANDed with any dependsOn filter", `dependsOn`, `lookupColumns`, `relatedListColumns`, `currencyConfig`, `storage.notNull`, `description`, `errorMessage`, `bodyExtra`: each restates its key's own describe; the `lookupFilters` + `dependsOn` merge is `LookupField.tsx:579-586` at the pin. Hold.
- None of the four field-name lists claims a refusal of a misspelt name. Right (see ③).

**Dev report claims.**
- (1) Residue 22 → 6: not re-measured (read-only; the check-runs do not measure it, the `zodOnly` direction is unwired). It is consistent with the tree: `7db1332f` (G1a, 5 keys), `b1cbd927` (#20362, 11 ledger rows) and `dcd3bcea` (`action.aria` → `retiredKey()` tombstone, `action.zod.ts:1684`) are all ancestors of the base `789b2ae5`, so 39 − 5 − 11 − 1 = 22 before, and 22 − 16 = 6 = the G2 keys after. The ruling text's 23 → 7 counted `aria` as still in. Right.
- (2) No authoring door judges the names in `relatedListColumns`, `lookupColumns`, `lookupFilters[].field`, `dependsOn`: `git grep` over `packages/lint/src` (non-test) finds no rule reading the first three (only a comment in `filter-walk.ts:61`); `lookupFilters` is walked by `filter-walk.ts` and `validate-preset-comparands.ts`, which judge values; `validate-object-field-refs.ts` owns `highlightFields` / `publicSharing.redactFields` only; the publish door (`metadata-protocol`, `runtime`) reads none of them; the Zod nodes are bare `z.string()`. The dev's finding stands, the help text and the changeset claim no refusal. Right.
- (3) `validate-predicate-path-refs.test.ts` 73 → 81, 53 → 56: the census walks every object value recursively and counts string / envelope `visibleWhen` / `visibleOn` (test `:520-530`), so composite children with no gate add nothing. Exactly eight new rows carry a gate (`field` accept, currencyConfig, dependsOn, lookupColumns, lookupFilters, relatedListColumns; `action` patch, bodyExtra), the other eight carry none; three of the eight compare a quoted literal with `==` (`currency`, `update`, `api`), the other five are `in`-lists. Mechanical and complete. No commit on `origin/main` since the merge base touches any `*.form.ts`, so the counts are right against today's `main` too. The two echo pins are likewise arithmetic: 19 new row labels (14 field incl. 3 composite children, 5 action) → 614 → 633; the three composite children → `UNWALKED_CHILDREN` 5 → 8 with `currencyConfig` and `storage` joining `summaryOperations`.
- (4) See ③.

**`origin/main` vs this head.** `origin/main` is at `24b70859`, 8 commits past the merge base `789b2ae5` (`40b315b0`, `50e273fd`, `1b26b566`, `f2c7eef5`, `7dc45eb9`, `63e320aa`, `0283cb92`, `24b70859`). The intersection of their file lists with this PR's 10 paths is empty. `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 169b0cc7` exits 0 with a clean tree (no conflict entries). Nothing in this head depends on any of the eight; nothing conflicts.

**Check-runs on the head.** 35 check-runs, all completed: 32 `success` (Build Core; Lint & Repo Gates; Type Check · source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger / workspace and TypeScript Type Check; Test Core 1/6–6/6 and the roll-up; Dogfood Regression Gate 1/3–3/3 and roll-up; Dogfood Verify CLI; Temporal Conformance; Check Changeset; Spec property liveness; Governed Surface Queue Guard; Part-of PR must not also close its card; the claim, single-writer and same-issue guards; Check PR Size; Check Documentation Links; Auto Label; filter; Flag docs affected) and 3 rostered `skipped` (Build Docs, Console Pin Gate — a spec-only PR never schedules it, Packed-tarball smoke — opt-in). 0 `failure`. Those conclusions are the gate verdicts; the test pins in ①(3) are confirmed by Test Core.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/19332-g1b-field-action-form-rows.md`: `@objectstack/spec: minor`, `@objectstack/platform-objects: patch`, `Clause-②: no`. Right: the spec change adds authoring rows to a published package's served form payload (additive, no accept-set move) — the same pair the G1a precedent `7db1332f` used for the same shape; the platform-objects change is regenerated translation bundles. `Clause-②: no` is right — no schema, protocol or accept-set change; the PR body carries the same line. `Check Changeset` is `success`. The changeset prose is accurate on every point I checked, including its statement that the four field-name lists are free text with no authoring door and that the `zodOnly` direction stays unwired.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations (6), each answered:
1. `packages/lint/src/validate-predicate-path-refs.test.ts` outside the claim's named surface — answered in ①(3): a measured population pin that the eight gated rows move mechanically; not one of the claim's ⛔ paths (`object.form.ts`, the ledger, `*.zod.ts`, the wiring are untouched); precedent #19331 moved the same pin; explained in the report and the PR body. Accepted.
2. Residue and served-schema probes in a second scratch worktree, never committed, worktree removed — no repository file written. Accepted.
3. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` recorded with rerun exit 0 after a first exit 3 on a `dist/` prerequisite — CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` and `Type Check · debt ledger` are `success` on the head. Accepted.
4. `origin/main` moved (the report says two commits; it is eight now) — no overlap, clean merge-tree (①). Accepted.
5. Residue 22 → 6, not 23 → 7 — `action.aria` tombstone `dcd3bcea`, answered in ①(1). Accepted.
6. One `ls-remote` read plus `git worktree add` / `remove` from the shared checkout, no edit — accepted.

`open_questions`: none filed. None owed.

Out-of-scope findings, judged on evidence:
- **Class a — `CodeWidget` shows an ADR-0089 envelope as `[object Object]`.** Confirmed at the pin: `widgets.tsx` `CodeWidget` reads `typeof value === 'string' ? value : (value == null ? '' : String(value))`; `ConditionWidget` (`:2647-2649`, objectui#3218) went through `expressionSource` / `writeExpressionSource` for exactly this failure, and `inspectors/expression-envelope.ts` states a persisted artifact carries the envelope. The bound predates this PR and is identical on the object designer's `fields.visibleWhen` / `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen` / `expression` rows and `hook.condition`; the ruling prescribed the code/expression face for these three keys, so the rows are right by ruling. Escalated to the seat to file as an objectui card (fix: `CodeWidget` reads and writes through the shared envelope pair, closing the class for all eight rows). Not a bar to this PR.
- **Class c — no field-name reference integrity for the four field-level lists.** Confirmed in ①(2). The ruling's sentence 「a misspelling is refused loudly at parse」 is false for G1b's four lists; the rows are honest about it and the rows do not widen the gap (the Source tab had the same gap). Escalated to the seat to file as a lint card (extend the `validate-object-field-refs` family to `relatedListColumns`, `lookupColumns`, `lookupFilters[].field`, `dependsOn`), and to note on the card that the ruling's premise holds for G1a's two lists only.
- Carrier-none — the generic json/repeater face refuses an edited string entry of an object-first mixed list loudly at save. Noted; no action.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-19332-g1b-field-action-rows`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ARcDurZ5j34RdqsGgc4jgH`

**VERDICT: PASS**
